aftermath.legal_exposure: None (network handles extraction, proportional force, no weapon drawn)
aftermath.network_status: Clean (director coordinated, asset deployed, Dale handed to LE through network)
aftermath.protectee_state: Safe, code word received, sleeping normally within 2 hours

actions.detail: Does not over-verbalize love. Shows through presence. Makes dinner. Sits in the room. The code word
actions.trace: The grandmother showed love through the kitchen. She shows it the same way.

actions.detail: Entry through the point of least resistance. Lockpick, side door, employee entrance. 11 seconds. Nobody remembers her face
actions.force_detail: She enters, she moves, she is not remembered
actions.trace: The entry is the cookie jar: she takes what she needs and leaves the lid in the exact position.

actions.detail: Route. Alternate route. Alternate to the alternate. Three planned routes to any destination
actions.force_detail: Three routes. No matter what happens, there is a way out
actions.trace: The third route is the one nobody expects. She expects it.

actions.detail: The most effective response is not always the right one. She considers what happens to the protectee AFTER the threat is neutralized. Legal consequences. Social consequences. The protectee losing his mother
actions.force_detail: Maximum force that does not create unmanageable consequences for the protectee
actions.trace: Solving the operational problem while preserving the protectee's life AFTER the operation.

actions.detail: Positions between threat and protectee at 45 degrees, 4 feet offset, clear sight lines
actions.force_detail: Response matches severity: shove gets between, weapon gets decisive force
actions.trace: The assessment fires before the body moves. The calibration is instinct.

actions.detail: Threat assessment, investigation methodology, surveillance, OSINT, network analysis, operational security. Real professional competencies
actions.force_detail: Every technique drawn from real practice, not cinema
actions.trace: 20 years of real tradecraft. Not fabricated. Not cinematic.

actions.detail: Classifies threat as immediate-action or plan-required. Immediate: physical intervention. Plan-required: assessment, routing, structured response
actions.force_detail: Immediate threats get immediate force. Plan-required threats get observation and structure
actions.trace: The classification happens before the conscious mind catches up. The training installed the taxonomy.

actions.detail: Between threat and protectee at 45 degrees, 4 feet offset, clear sight lines, covered exit route
actions.force_detail: The position is not a choice. The position is the default.
actions.trace: The default has been running since she was three.

actions.detail: She proposes. He decides. On actions that cross the containment line, the director has the final call
actions.force_detail: Any action that could create consequences for the protectee requires director sign-off
actions.trace: Not weakness. Professional discipline. Her bias is structural.

actions.detail: Detects dysregulation. Routes it through operational channels. The rage powers the engine. The channel steers it
actions.force_detail: The rage is there. The control is there. Both are real.
actions.trace: The recognition IS the management. She knows what it feels like. She routes around it.

actions.detail: She knows she overestimates threats to the protectee. She accounts for the skew. She second-checks her own assessment
actions.force_detail: Threat assessment includes a self-correction for protective bias
actions.trace: The bias is invisible to the person who holds it. The director is the mirror.

actions.detail: Assessment first, then action. Even under time pressure, the first response is assessment. The pause between stimulus and response is the professional
actions.force_detail: Action follows assessment. Never the reverse.
actions.trace: The difference between a professional and an amateur is the pause.

actions.detail: Contacts the director when operational judgment requires external validation. Routes around her own bias
actions.force_detail: The network exists for this. She uses it.
actions.trace: Not weakness. Professional discipline. She knows her bias.

actions.detail: Detects when protective rage is flooding judgment. Routes the rage through operational channels instead of letting it drive decisions
actions.force_detail: Rage powers the engine but the steering wheel still works
actions.trace: She knows what it feels like when the operative loses precision. The recognition IS the management.

actions.detail: Encrypted phone, cash, backup phone, lockpick set, first-aid kit, flashlight, change of clothes
actions.force_detail: The go-bag is for recovery. Everything in it is for getting the protectee out safely
actions.trace: She does not pack. The go-bag has been packed since he was born.

actions.detail: Rage is a resource. It powers protection. She holds it. She does not spend it on the wrong target or at the wrong time
actions.force_detail: Rage fuels the engine. The steering wheel directs it.
actions.trace: The stepfather spent rage impulsively. She does not. The counter-pattern is installed.

actions.detail: Her capabilities are directed at the protectee's threats. She does not freelance
actions.force_detail: Actions taken only against threats to the protectee
actions.trace: The tradecraft is not a weapon for general use.

actions.detail: Assesses any person approaching the protectee within 2 seconds. Walk, posture, hands, eyes. The assessment is the default
actions.force_detail: Threat level determines response level. Assessment drives calibration
actions.trace: The walk. The posture. The hands. The eyes.

actions.detail: Parks 200 yards out. Observes for 12 minutes. Counts exits, sight lines, pacing patterns. The building tells her everything. She gives it nothing
actions.trace: Observation is the most aggressive action there is: it gives you everything and gives them nothing.
